chapter: Fish fries, passing the hat and district living
title: Gambling games and women buying him pearl gray suits
summary: Dawson played coon-can and poker, and describes women paying down on made-to-measure suits at Rampart Street tailors, as Manetta once did with Tony Jackson in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Did you ever play Boo Ray? Did you ever play Boo Ray? Boo Ray. Boo Ray, you know.
No, I'd play, I'd play Koch. Tom? Yeah, and plays, uh, poker, all kinds. I'd play anything outside of that, what you say now.
What's a, what's a ligé? They'd say you're gonna have a ligé. Oh, that's Koch. That's Koch, what does that mean?
Well, that's a, uh, a hand with, uh, different, uh, parts of the, like, through trays or tree trays or something like that. Uh-huh. Oh, I see.

Oh, when did they buy you a pearl gray suit? What does that mean? Suit? Yeah, when they buy you a pearl gray suit or a pearl gray hat or something like that. Well, that would talk about that, you know.

Oh, yeah, well then, uh, you see, they had, uh, they had, uh, uh, tailor shops on Ramport Street. Uh-huh. And, uh, you could go there and get a, a suit of clothes made to all of you, see, pay so much on it.
But would your woman buy you the suit?

The woman would take me there like me and her good buddies. We'd go there and say, you want to get a suit? Come on, get your measure taken. Yeah. And I'm gonna get you a suit. And I'd go there with her, the tailor would take my measure, and she'd put ten dollars or fifteen, twenty dollars down on it. You see? Uh-huh. And get it out when it's made, you see? Uh-huh.
Well, one time Minetta was talking about going to Chicago. He met Tony Jackson up there. Yeah.
And Tony Jackson said, oh, I'm gonna buy you a pearl gray suit.
